sections.title: 英语知识运用
sections.directions: Directions: Read the following text. Choose the best word(s) for each numbered blank and mark A, B, C or D on the ANSWER SHEET. (10 points)

blocks.content: Your social life is defined as "the activities you do with other people, for pleasure, when you are not working". It's important to have a social life, but what's right for one person won't be right for another. Some of us feel energised by spending lots of time with others,
some of us may feel drained, even if it's doing something we enjoy. This is why finding a

questions.analysis: whereas 【线索】同句左右两半呈正反对照 原文 Some of us feel energised by spending lots of time with others, __(1)__ some of us may feel drained, even if it's doing something we enjoy：左半 "被激发能量"，右半 【选项】A) because ✗ 错因：把 "对照" 误读成 "因果" because 表因果，意为 "因为他人感到 energised，所以另一些人 drained"，逻辑上不成立—— B) unless ✗ 错因：条件关系与原文无关 unless = if not，表 "除非"，会得出 "除非他人 drained 否则被 energised"，与原句平行对照的结 C) whereas ✓ 正解：典型对照连词 whereas = while，用于将两个并列主语的相反行为/感受作对照，恰好串起 feel energised 与 feel drained，并与下文 even if it's doing something we enjoy 的 "即使是喜欢的事" 的让步 D) until ✗ 错因：时间界限与本句无关 【验证】代入后整句为 Some of us feel energised by spending lots of time with others, __(1)__ some of us may feel drained，"一些人被激发能量，而另一些人却被耗尽"——与 outline 中 P1 "social life 因人而异" 的对照定调完全契合。

balance 【线索】P2 与 P4 一正一反共同呼应 "平衡" 主旨 P2 开篇 This is why finding a __(2)__ in your social life is key 后紧接 "独处太多 → 孤 独"；P4 On the other hand, it's __(14)__ possible to have too much of a social life 又 【选项】A) contrast ✗ 错因：含义偏 "对比" 而非 "调和" B) balance ✓ 正解：贯通 P2/P4 两端的 "平衡" balance 恰好是 "独处 vs 社交" 两端之间的中点；与 P4 On the other hand 后的 "too much" C) link ✗ 错因："联系" 与文章议题无关 link = 联系/纽带，常用于事物间关系（如 link between A and B），原句 a ___ in your social D) gap ✗ 错因：方向相反 gap = 缺口/差距，"在 social life 中找到 gap" 反而暗示 "留白/空缺"，与文章后文 "既要避免孤独 【验证】代入后 finding a balance in your social life is key，对应 P4 的 too much of a social life

seeing 【线索】上下文围绕 "独处 → 孤独" 原文 Spending too much time on your own, not __(3)__ others, can make you feel lonely and __(4)__：左边 on your own 暗示 "独处过多"，右边导致 lonely——所填动作 【选项】 A) seeing ✓ 正解："见面" 直接对治 "独处过多" seeing others = "和别人见面"，是 social life 最朴素的形式；"不见人" 自然 "独处太多" 进而 feel lonely。 B) pleasing ✗ 错因：与 social life 主线无关 pleasing others = "取悦别人"，原文不在讨论是否 "讨好" 他人，且 "不讨好他人" 与 "孤独" 之间 C) judging ✗ 错因：色彩偏负面，方向相反 D) teaching ✗ 错因：动作过于具体、超出语境 【验证】代入后 Spending too much time on your own, not seeing others, can make you feel lonely and __(4)__，"独处过多、不见别人 → 孤独"，因果链条朴素而自洽，与 P2 "独处之

disconnected 【线索】lonely 决定并列形容词应同向 can make you feel lonely and __(4)__：lonely 是负面情绪、且强调 "与他人无连接"。所 【选项】A) misguided ✗ 错因：语义场是 "被误导"，与孤独无关 misguided = 被误导的，常与 belief/decision 搭配，不与 lonely 共一情感场。 B) surprised ✗ 错因：情绪场不同 C) spoiled ✗ 错因：方向反转 D) disconnected ✓ 正解："与他人脱节" 与 lonely 同源同向 disconnected = 失去连接的，正对应上文 not __(3)__ others 的 "不见他人"——"不见 → 失联 【验证】代入后 can make you feel lonely and disconnected，"孤独且与他人脱节" 形成同向并 列，自然衔接上一句的 "not seeing others"，与 P2 主线一致。

contribute to 【线索】loneliness 的负面效应链 原文 Loneliness is known to impact on your mental health and __(5)__ a low mood： 和并列项 impact on your mental health 一致，本空也应表达 "loneliness 对 low mood 【选项】 A) contribute to ✓ 正解："促成 → 低落" 与前并列一致 contribute to 既可表 "贡献于" 也可表 "促成（消极结果）"——loneliness contribute to a low mood 即 "孤独感会促成低落情绪"，方向与 impact on your mental health 同向。 B) rely on ✗ 错因："依赖" 不符合主语角色 rely on = 依赖；"孤独依赖于低落" 句义颠倒、不通。 C) interfere with ✗ 错因：意为 "干扰"，与 a low mood 不搭 interfere with 的宾语通常是 "被破坏的好东西"（sleep, work），不会用 "干扰一个低落情绪"。 D) go against ✗ 错因：方向相反 【验证】代入后 Loneliness is known to impact on your mental health and contribute to a low

for example 【线索】前句抽象、空后给出具体场景 原文 Anyone can feel lonely at any time. This might be especially true if, __(6)__, you are working from home and you are __(7)__ on the usual social conversations that happen in an office：前一句是抽象判断 "任何人都可能孤独"，空后接 "在家工作" 这一具 【选项】A) in fact ✗ 错因：常用于 "递进强调或反差"，与本句结构不符 B) of course ✗ 错因：表 "理所当然"，与举例不搭 of course = 当然，表共识/让步，不引具体事例。 C) for example ✓ 正解：抽象 → 具体的标准信号 for example 正好把前句 "any time/特别真切" 的抽象判断与 "working from home" 的具体场 D) on average ✗ 错因：表 "平均而言"，需要数据语境 【验证】代入后 This might be especially true if, for example, you are working from 中 P2 "用 working from home 举例论证孤独成因" 的脉络。

missing out 【线索】+on 的常用搭配 + 上下文 "在家工作错失办公室寒暄" 原文 if, __(6)__, you are working from home and you are __(7)__ on the usual social conversations that happen in an office：在家工作 → 错过了办公室里日常社交对话。"错 过" 常用搭配是 miss out on。 【选项】A) cutting back ✗ 错因：搭配多用 on 但意为 "削减"，主观能动 cutting back on = 削减/缩减（如 cut back on sugar），表主动减少；本句是 "被动错过"，主语 B) missing out ✓ 正解：miss out on = 错过 missing out on = 错过（机会、活动）。"在家工作 → 错过办公室日常社交对话" 因果顺、搭配 C) breaking in ✗ 错因：搭配与语义都不对 breaking in 多与 on 搭配指 "插话/打断（谈话）"，但需要主语在场打断，与 "在家工作" 物理冲 D) looking down ✗ 错因：look down on = 看不起，色彩负面 looking down on = 鄙视/看低；"看不起办公室寒暄" 与上文 "孤独" 主线不搭。 【验证】代入后 you are working from home and you are missing out on the usual social conversations that happen in an office——"在家办公，错过了办公室里日常的社交对 话"，正好为前文 "working from home 容易孤独" 提供原因。

trigger 【线索】举例支持 "引发 → 孤独期" 原文 Other life changes can __(8)__ periods of loneliness too, such as retirement, changing jobs or becoming a parent："退休、换工作、成为父母" 都是 "导致一段孤独 【选项】A) shorten ✗ 错因：方向相反 shorten = 缩短，"生活变化缩短孤独期" 与 "造成孤独" 主线反。 B) trigger ✓ 正解：引发 / 触发，正好对应 "诱因" 文 contribute to a low mood 的因果框架。 C) follow ✗ 错因：方向颠倒 D) interrupt ✗ 错因：意为 "打断"，与 "造成" 相反 【验证】代入后 Other life changes can trigger periods of loneliness too, such as retirement, changing jobs or becoming a parent——"其他生活变化也会触发孤独期，比如退休/换

regain 【线索】P3 提供 "重建社交" 的具体方法 原文 It's important to recognise these feelings of loneliness. There are ways to __(9)__ a social life，下文给出 "从兴趣入手、加入团体、结识 like-minded 的人" 等做法 【选项】A) assess ✗ 错因："评估" 与后文具体行动不接 B) interpret ✗ 错因："解释" 不与 a social life 搭配 C) provide ✗ 错因：主体错位 provide = 提供，"有方法去 provide a social life" 暗含 "由谁提供给谁"，主体错位——文章是教 D) regain ✓ 正解："重新获得 / 找回" 【验证】代入后 There are ways to regain a social life，"有办法重新获得社交生活"，与下文 "从兴

at first 【线索】下一句紧接 "先从兴趣入手"——暗示 "起步阶段" 原文 There are ways to __(9)__ a social life, but it can feel overwhelming __(10)__. It's a great idea to start by thinking about hobbies you enjoy：but 提示 "虽有办法但起 "起初"。 【选项】 A) at first ✓ 正解："起初" 与下句 start by 完全呼应 at first = 起初，"起初会觉得 overwhelming，但可以从你喜欢的爱好入手"——前后构成 "起步 B) in turn ✗ 错因："依次/反过来" 与本句逻辑无关 C) on time ✗ 错因：意为 "准时"，与情绪 overwhelming 不搭 on time 修饰 "是否准时"，常用于交付/到达；情绪状态用 on time 修饰不合理。 D) by chance ✗ 错因："偶然" 与 "起步阶段" 无关 【验证】代入后 it can feel overwhelming at first. It's a great idea to start by thinking about hobbies you enjoy——"起初会让人不堪重负。可以从你喜欢的爱好开始着手"，前 at first 与后 start by 形成时间链，自然顺。

like-minded 【线索】前文提兴趣团体，下文列同好群体 原文 find groups and activities related to those where you will be able to meet __(11)__ people 紧接 There are groups aimed at new parents, at those who want to __(12)__ a new sport for the first time, or networking events for those in the same profession——所遇之人都是 "志同道合者"，与 "兴趣/职业相同" 直接对应。 【选项】A) far-sighted ✗ 错因："有远见的" 与 "兴趣团体" 主线无关 B) strong-willed ✗ 错因："意志坚定" 与 "共同爱好" 不对应 C) kind-hearted ✗ 错因："好心" 偏品德，不指向 "共同兴趣" D) like-minded ✓ 正解："志同道合" 直对应共同兴趣 【验证】代入后 you will be able to meet like-minded people——"你将能遇到志趣相投的人"，

try 【线索】for the first time 锁定 "首次尝试" 原文 those who want to __(12)__ a new sport for the first time——"想第一次 ___ 一项 新运动的人"。线索极强：能与 "for the first time" 自然搭配且最常被作动词的就是 try。 【选项】 A) try ✓ 正解：try a new sport for the first time = 第一次尝试一项新运动 try 与 for the first time 是黄金搭配，且下文 "加入团体" 的人群就是 "想初次尝试某项运动 者"，符合 P3 "鼓励起步" 的口吻。 B) promote ✗ 错因："推广" 主体错位 C) watch ✗ 错因："观看" 与 social life 主线不符 social connection。 D) describe ✗ 错因："描述" 与 sport 搭配语义不通 【验证】代入后 those who want to try a new sport for the first time——"想第一次尝试一项新 运动的人"，与上文 like-minded people "志趣相投者" 一脉相承，体现 P3 "以兴趣为入口

share 【线索】networking events 目的=互通有无 原文 networking events for those in the same profession to meet up and __(13)__ ideas——"同行 networking 见面" 的常见目的是 "交换/分享想法"。 【选项】A) test ✗ 错因："测试" 偏实验/产品语境 test ideas 多用于 "检验假设"，networking event 不是实验场合。 B) share ✓ 正解：分享想法是 networking 的标准动作 share ideas = 分享想法，是同行见面的最自然目的，与 meet up 并列毫无违和感。 C) accept ✗ 错因："接受" 单向，networking 是双向交流 accept ideas = 接受想法，单向接受，不符合 networking 双向交流的常识。 D) revise ✗ 错因："修订" 缺前提 【验证】代入后 to meet up and share ideas——"见面并分享想法"，正是 networking 的典型目

also 【线索】段首 On the other hand 暗示并列对立 原文 On the other hand, it's __(14)__ possible to have too much of a social life：On 【选项】A) already ✗ 错因："已经" 表示时间完成，与 possible 不搭 B) thus ✗ 错因："因此" 表因果，与对照矛盾 thus = 因此；段首已有 On the other hand 表 "另一面"，再 thus 因果会自相矛盾。 C) also ✓ 正解："也可能" 与 "另一面" 并列同向 also = 也，表 "另一面同样存在的可能性"，与 On the other hand 构成 "两侧均可能" 的对照- D) only ✗ 错因："仅仅" 缩小范围，文意不符 【验证】代入后 On the other hand, it's also possible to have too much of a social life——"另 outline 主轴。

space 【线索】downtime 需要 "留白" 原文 If you feel like you're always doing something and there is never any __(15)__ in your calendar for downtime：always doing something 与 never any ___ 形成对比， downtime（放松时间）必须有 "空档 / 空白" 才能发生。 【选项】A) list ✗ 错因：list 与 downtime 不搭 list = 清单，"日程表里没有给放松留清单" 句义别扭，且 list 本身就是 calendar 的内容形式，并 非 "留白"。 B) order ✗ 错因："顺序/订单" 与 downtime 无关 order = 顺序/订单，搭 calendar / downtime 无固定意义。 C) space ✓ 正解："留白 / 空档" 正合 downtime 用 space in your calendar = 日程表里的空档，是英语对 "留白时间" 的标准表达，与 downtime D) boundary ✗ 错因："边界" 是 "分割" 而非 "留出" 【验证】代入后 there is never any space in your calendar for downtime——"日程表里从来没有 给停机留任何空档"，与上文 always doing something 形成 "满-空" 自然反差，符合 P4

fatigue 【线索】social burnout = social ___ 同义替换 原文 you could suffer social burnout or social __(16)__：burnout 本意 "精疲力竭"；or 【选项】 A) fatigue ✓ 正解：social fatigue 与 social burnout 同义同向 fatigue = 疲劳；social fatigue 是 social burnout 的通用说法，or 并列同向，下文紧接 low energy, irritability and trouble sleeping 也都是疲劳症状。 B) criticism ✗ 错因："批评" 与 burnout 不同场 criticism = 批评，是言语行为，不是身心状态。 C) injustice ✗ 错因："不公正" 与 burnout 无关 injustice = 不公正，与 "社交耗竭" 完全不同语域。 D) dilemma ✗ 错因："困境" 偏决策，与 burnout 不同向 dilemma = 两难，强调选择困境，不是 "心力耗竭"。 【验证】代入后 you could suffer social burnout or social fatigue——"你会经历社交耗竭或社交

signs 【线索】列举出的都是 "表现"，不是 "成因" 原文 Low mood, low energy, irritability and trouble sleeping could all be __(17)__ of poor social health：列举的都是 "被社交健康差体现出的现象"，属于症状/迹象。 【选项】A) sources ✗ 错因："来源" 把因果倒置 sources = 来源/根源；列举的是 poor social health 的结果，不是它的源头。最易诱人，但方 B) standards ✗ 错因："标准" 不合语义 C) signs ✓ 正解："迹象" 与 "列举症状" 完美对位 social 过度" 的总结句。 D) scores ✗ 错因："得分" 需要量化语境 【验证】代入后 Low mood, low energy, irritability and trouble sleeping could all be signs of poor social health——"它们都可能是社交健康不佳的迹象"，与 P4 "识别 social 过度" 的

mark out 【线索】下文给出 "留出来的目的"——休息、放松、恢复 原文 Make sure you __(18)__ some time in your diary when you're __(19)__ for socialising and use this time to relax, __(20)__ and recover：动作的目的是 "用这段时间 relax / recover"——即 "专门划出一段时间"。 【选项】A) take over ✗ 错因："接管" 与 "留时间" 不同义 take over = 接管/接手，常用于 "接手职位/任务"，不能搭 some time。 B) wipe off ✗ 错因："擦去" 方向相反 wipe off = 擦掉/抹去；"擦掉日程里的时间" 与 "留出一段时间" 相反。 C) add up ✗ 错因："累加/合计" 不搭 "日程留时" add up = 加起来/合计，宾语多为数字，搭 some time in your diary 不通。 D) mark out ✓ 正解："在日程里划/标出一段时间" mark out = 标出/划出，正合 "在 diary 里专门划一段时间用于不社交、休息"。 【验证】代入后 Make sure you mark out some time in your diary when you're __(19)__ for this time to relax, __(20)__ and recover 衔接顺畅。

unavailable 【线索】段意是 "专门划出不社交的时间" 原文 Make sure you __(18)__ some time in your diary when you're __(19)__ for socialising and use this time to relax：when you're ___ for socialising 与 use this 社交"。 【选项】A) ungrateful ✗ 错因："不感激" 不搭 socialising ungrateful = 不感激的，常 ungrateful to / for sb，且语义与 "留时间放松" 无关。 B) unavailable ✓ 正解："无法参加社交" 与 "专门留出" 对位 unavailable for socialising = 没空 / 不能参加社交；与 "在日程里划出一段时间专门用来不社 C) responsible ✗ 错因："对……负责" 方向反 responsible for socialising = 对社交负责，意思偏 "承担起社交任务"，与 "留出不社交的时间" D) regretful ✗ 错因："后悔" 是情绪词，与 "是否抽得开身" 无关 regretful = 后悔的，不能解释 "为什么这段时间能用来 relax"。 【验证】代入后 some time in your diary when you're unavailable for socialising and use this

It's important to have a social life, but what's right for one person won't be right for another. 本句成分丰富且包含多个训练价值点：形式主语 "It" 与真正主语 "to have a social life" 的识别，主 语从句 "what's right for one person" 作主语的用法，以及并列主句中各自的主系表结构划分。这 Some of us feel ...

sections.title: 阅读理解
sections.directions: Read the following four texts. Answer the questions after each text by choosing A, B, C or D. Mark your answers on the ANSWER SHEET. (40 points)

blocks.content: In her new book Cogs and Monsters: What Economics Is, and What It Should Be, Diane Coyle, an economist at Cambridge University, argues that the digital economy requires new ways of thinking about progress. "Whatever we mean by the economy growing, by things getting better, the gains will have to be more evenly shared than in the recent past," she writes. "An economy of tech millionaires or billionaires and gig workers, with middle-income jobs undercut by automation, will not be politically sustainable." Improving living standards and increasing prosperity for more people will require greater use of digital technologies to boost productivity in various sectors, including health care and construction, says Coyle. But people can't be expected to embrace the changes if they're not seeing the benefits—if they're just seeing good jobs being destroyed. In a recent interview, Coyle said she fears that tech's inequality problem could be a roadblock to deploying AI. "We're talking about disruption," she says. "These are transformative technologies that change the ways we spend our time every day, that change business models that succeed." To make such "tremendous changes," she adds, you need social buy-in. Instead, says Coyle, resentment is simmering among many as the benefits are perceived to go to elites in a handful of prosperous cities. According to the Brookings Institution, a short list of eight American cities that included San Francisco, San Jose, Boston, and Seattle had roughly 38% of all tech jobs by 2019. New AI technologies are particularly concentrated: Brookings's Mark Muro and Sifan Liu estimate that just 15 cities account for two-thirds of the AI assets and capabilities in the United States. The dominance of a few cities in the invention and commercialization of AI means that geographical disparities in wealth will continue to soar. Not only will this foster political and social unrest, but it could, as Coyle suggests, hold back the sorts of AI technologies needed for regional economies to grow. Part of the solution could lie in somehow loosening the stranglehold that Big Tech has on defining the AI agenda. That will likely take increased federal funding for research independent of the tech giants. A more immediate response is to broaden our digital imaginations to conceive of AI technologies that don't simply replace jobs but expand opportunities in the sectors that different parts of the country care most about, like health care, education, and manufacturing.

The UK is facing a future construction crisis because of a failure to plant trees to produce wood, Confor has warned. The forestry and wood trade body has called for urgent action to reduce the country's reliance on timber imports and provide a stable supply of wood for future generations. Currently only 20 percent of the UK's wood requirement is home-grown while it remains the second-largest net importer of timber in the world. Coming at a time of fresh incentives from the UK government for landowners to grow more trees, the trade body says these don't go far enough and fail to promote the benefits of planting them to boost timber supplies. "Not only are we facing a carbon crisis now, but we will also be facing a future construction crisis because of a failure to plant trees to produce wood," said Stuart Goodall, chief executive of Confor. "For decades we have not taken responsibility for investing in our domestic wood supply, leaving us exposed to fluctuating prices and fighting for future supplies of wood as global demand rises and our own supplies fall." The UK has ideal conditions for growing wood to build low-carbon homes and is a global leader in certifying that its forests are sustainably managed, Confor says. While around three quarters of Scottish homes are built from Scottish timber, the use of home-grown wood in England is only around 25 percent. The causes of the UK's current position are complex and range from outdated perceptions of productive forestry to the decimation of trees by grey squirrels. It also encompasses significant hesitation on behalf of farmers and other landowners to invest in longer-term planting projects. While productive tree planting can deliver real financial benefits to rural economies and contribute to the UK's net-zero strategy, the focus of government support continues to be on food production and the rewilding and planting of native woodland solely for biodiversity. Goodall added: "While food production and biodiversity health are clearly of critical importance, we need our land to also provide secure supplies of wood for construction, manufacturing and contribute to net zero." "While the UK government has stated its ambition for more tree planting, there has been little action on the ground. Confor is now calling for much greater impetus behind those aspirations to ensure we have enough wood to meet increasing demand."

One of the biggest challenges in keeping unsafe aging drivers off the road is convincing them that it's time to turn over the keys. "It's a complete life-changer" when someone stops—or is forced to stop—driving, said former risk manager Anne M. Menke. "The American Medical Association advises physicians that 'in situations where clear evidence of substantial driving impairment implies a strong threat to patient and public safety, and where the physician's advice to discontinue driving privileges is ignored, it is desirable and ethical to notify the Department of Motor Vehicles,'" Menke wrote. "Some states require physicians to report, others allow but do not mandate reports, while a few consider a report a breach of confidentiality. There could be liability and penalties if a physician does not act in accordance with state laws on reporting and confidentiality," she counseled. Part of the problem in keeping older drivers safe is that the difficulties are addressed piecemeal by different professions with different focuses, including gerontologists, highway administration officials, automotive engineers and others, said gerontologist Elizabeth Dugan. "There's not a National Institute of Older Driver Studies," she said. "We need better evidence on what makes drivers unsafe" and what can help, said Dugan. One thing that does seem to work is requiring drivers to report in person for license renewal. Mandatory in- person renewal was associated with a 31 percent reduction in fatal crashes involving drivers 85 or older, according to one study. Passing vision tests also produced a similar decline in fatal crashes for those drivers, although there appeared to be no benefit from combining the two. Many older drivers don't see eye doctors or can't afford to. Primary care providers have their hands full and may not be able to follow through with patients who have trouble driving because they can't turn their heads or remember where they are going—or have gotten shorter and haven't changed their seat settings sufficiently to reach car pedals easily. As long as there are other cars on the roads, self-driving cars won't solve the problems of crashes, said Dugan. Avoiding dangers posed by all those human drivers would require too many algorithms, she said. But we need to do more to improve safety, said Dugan. "If we're going to have 100-year lives, we need cars that a 90- year-old can drive comfortably."

If you look at the apps on your phone, chances are you have at least one related to your health—and probably several. Whether it is a mental health app, a fitness tracker, a connected health device or something else, many of us are taking advantage of this technology to keep better track of our health in some shape or form. Recent research from the Organization for the Review of Care and Health Applications found that 350,000 health apps were available on the market, 90,000 of which launched in 2020 alone. While these apps have a great deal to offer, it is not always clear how the personal information we input is collected, safeguarded and shared online. Existing health privacy law, such as the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act, is primarily focused on the way hospitals, doctors' offices, clinics and insurance companies store health records online. The health information these apps and health data tracking wearables are collecting typically does not receive the same legal protections. Without additional protections in place, companies may share (and potentially monetize) personal health information in a way consumers may not have authorized or anticipated. In 2021, Flo Health faced a Federal Trade Commission (FTC) investigation. The FTC alleged in a complaint that "despite express privacy claims, the company took control of users' sensitive fertility data and shared it with third parties." Flo Health and the FTC settled the matter with a Consent Order requiring the company to get app users' express affirmative consent before sharing their health information as well as to instruct the third parties to delete the data they had obtained. Section 5 of the FTC Act empowers the FTC to initiate enforcement action against unfair or deceptive acts, meaning the FTC can only act after the fact if a company's privacy practices are misleading or cause unjustified consumer harm. While the FTC is doing what it can to ensure apps are keeping their promises to consumers around the handling of their sensitive health information, the rate at which these health apps are hitting the market demonstrates just how immense of a challenge this is. As to the prospects for federal legislation, commentators suggest that comprehensive federal privacy legislation seems unlikely in the short term. States have begun implementing their own solutions to shore up protections for consumer-generated health data. California has been at the forefront of state privacy efforts with the California Consumer Privacy Act of 2018. Virginia, Colorado and Utah have also recently passed state consumer data privacy legislation.

questions.question: Coyle argues in her new book that economic growth should_______.
questions.analysis: 【判型】argues in her new book that economic growth should 直接问书中的具体主张，是对原 【拆句】Coyle argues in her new book that economic growth should 主句主谓是 Coyle argues，that 引导宾语从句，从句主语 economic growth，谓语 should + 选项内容，四 【定位】P1 Whatever we mean by the economy growing, by things getting better, the gains will have to be more evenly shared than in the recent past. 【选项】A) 无中生有 give rise to innovations 谈的是经济增长应催生创新，但定位句只讲收益要均匀分享， diversify career choices 暗示多元化职业选择，原文 middle-income jobs undercut C) ✓ 正确 the gains will have to be more evenly shared ↔ benefit people equally C 项 benefit people equally 与预判的“收益更平均分配”完全一致，是定位句的标准同 度；原文亦无任何 promote/push/forcefully 类表述。

questions.question: According to Paragraph 2, digital technologies should be used to_______.
questions.analysis: 【判型】digital technologies should be used to 直接对应原文某一目的状语，属于客观信息 【拆句】According to Paragraph 2, digital technologies should be used to 句首 According to 是来源状语，主句主语 digital technologies，谓语 should be used，to + 动词原形作目 【定位】P2 Improving living standards and increasing prosperity for more people will require greater use of digital technologies to boost productivity in various sectors, including health care and construction, says Coyle. 【选项】A) 过度推断 bring about instant prosperity 强调“立即带来繁荣”，原文 Improving living standards and increasing prosperity for more people 只说要改善生活、增加更多人 reduce people's workload 谈减轻工作量，原文 good jobs being destroyed 是说好 C) ✓ 正确 boost productivity in various sectors ↔ raise overall work efficiency enhance cross-sector cooperation 主张促进跨部门合作，原文 in various sectors, including health care and construction 只是列举技术应用的行业范围，并未提行业之

questions.question: What does Coyle fear about transformative technologies?

options.B: They may be impractical to deploy.
options.D: They may be unwelcome to the public.

questions.analysis: 【判型】What does Coyle fear about transformative technologies 问她担忧的具体对象，对应 【拆句】What does Coyle fear about transformative technologies? 特殊疑问句，What 作 fear 的宾语，about transformative technologies 是宾语限定范围。选项均为 They may + 动 词原形，主语 They 回指 transformative technologies。无陷阱。 【定位】P3 Coyle said she fears that tech's inequality problem could be a roadblock to deploying AI. ... To make such "tremendous changes," she adds, you need social buy-in. 【选项】A) 偷换概念 affect work-life balance 谈工作生活平衡，原文 change the ways we spend our impractical to deploy 说技术不切实际、难以部署，原文 tech's inequality problem could be a roadblock to deploying AI 说障碍来自不平等而非技术本身不实用；Coyle incur huge expenditure 谈巨额开支，全段乃至全文都未出现 cost/expenditure/spending 类经济成本表述。 D) ✓ 正确 you need social buy-in ↔ unwelcome to the public tech's inequality problem could be a roadblock to deploying AI ↔ unwelcome to the public

options.A: the uneven distribution of AI technologies in the US

questions.analysis: 【判型】are mentioned to show 直接问列举目的，是典型例证题题干特征。 【拆句】Several American cities are mentioned to show 主语 Several American cities，被动谓 语 are mentioned，to show + 选项内容作目的状语。注意：答案在原文这些城市出现处 【定位】P5 According to the Brookings Institution, a short list of eight American cities that included San Francisco, San Jose, Boston, and Seattle had roughly 38% of all tech jobs by 2019. New AI technologies are particularly concentrated: Brookings's Mark Muro and Sifan Liu estimate that just 15 cities account for two-thirds of the AI assets and capabilities in the United States. 市约占全部科技岗位的 38%。新 AI 技术尤其集中：布鲁金斯学会的 Mark Muro 和 Sifan 【选项】A) ✓ 正确 New AI technologies are particularly concentrated ↔ the uneven distribution of AI technologies in the US just 15 cities account for two-thirds of the AI assets and capabilities in the United States ↔ uneven distribution of AI technologies in the US the disappointing prospect of tech jobs 强调“令人失望的前景”，原文 had roughly 38% of all tech jobs by 2019 只是描述现状的分布数据，并未谈未来的失望走势。 the fast progress of US regional economies 说区域经济快速发展，原文 hold back the sorts of AI technologies needed for regional economies to grow 明确说区域经 the increasing significance of US AI assets 谈 AI 资产愈发重要，原文 two-thirds of the AI assets and capabilities 谈的是 AI 资产的“分布集中”而非其“重要性增长”；题干

options.A: raising funds to start new AI projects
options.C: guarding against the side effects of AI
options.D: redefining the role of AI technologies

questions.analysis: 关于Coyle的担忧,作者建议______。 【判型】the author suggests 直接问作者给出的具体建议，是末段事实层信息提取。 【拆句】With regard to Coyle's concern, the author suggests With regard to 引导话题状语， 主句主语 the author，谓语 suggests，宾语为选项内容（动名词短语）。选项均为 V-ing 【定位】P8 A more immediate response is to broaden our digital imaginations to conceive of AI technologies that don't simply replace jobs but expand opportunities in the sectors that different parts of the country care most about, like health care, education, and manufacturing. 【选项】A) 偷换概念 raising funds to start new AI projects 是要为新 AI 项目筹资，原文 increased federal funding for research independent of the tech giants 说的是为“独立于科技 巨头的研究”增加联邦资金，对象是 research 而非 new AI projects，且第 25 题的回指 Coyle's concern 由文本 a more immediate response 指向第 8 段，而非第 7 段。 encouraging collaboration in AI research 说鼓励 AI 研究中的合作，原文 research independent of the tech giants 只是强调研究要独立于科技巨头，未提合作；其他段 也无 collaboration/cooperation 之意。 guarding against the side effects of AI 主张防范副作用，原文 don't simply replace jobs but expand opportunities 给出的是积极重塑的方案，而非提防危险，建议色彩 D) ✓ 正确 broaden our digital imaginations to conceive of AI technologies that don't simply replace jobs but expand opportunities ↔ redefining the role of AI technologies SENTENCE INSIGHTS · 句子精讲 9 "Whatever we mean by the economy growing, by things getting better, the gains will have to be more evenly shared than in the recent past," she writes. Improving living standards and increasing prosperity for more people will require greater use of digital technologies to boos...

questions.question: It can be learned from Paragraph 1 that the UK needs to______.

options.D: lift its control on timber imports

questions.analysis: 【判型】题干用 It can be learned from Paragraph 1，要求从该段直接读出，未含 infer/imply/mainly about 等推断或主旨信号。 【拆句】It can be learned from Paragraph 1 that the UK needs to______ 句子主干是形式主语 It + 被动 can be learned，从句 that 引导宾语从句；空格是宾语从句里 needs to 之后的动 【定位】P1 Currently only 20 percent of the UK's wood requirement is home-grown while it remains the second-largest net importer of timber in the world. 【选项】A) ✓ 正确 only 20 percent of the UK's wood requirement is home-grown ↔ increase its domestic wood supply home-grown ↔ domestic 预判"提高本土供给"与 increase its domestic wood supply 在动作（increase）、对象 （domestic wood supply）、方向（提升自给率）三处完全对位，故选 A。 原文呼吁的是供给端扩产，而 reduce its demand for timber 把动作偷换成需求端"减 少使用"；段首甚至预警 future construction crisis，正是因为建筑需求不会减。 首段未涉及木材的生产成本，lower its wood production costs 中的 production 原文意在减少进口依赖，而 lift its control on timber imports 等于放开进口管制，反

questions.question: According to Confor, the UK government's fresh incentives______.

options.A: can hardly address a construction crisis
options.B: are believed to come at a wrong time
options.C: seem to be misleading for landowners
options.D: will be too costly to put into practice

questions.analysis: 【判型】题干 According to Confor 限定来源，问 fresh incentives 的具体评价，是对原文一段话的 【拆句】According to Confor, the UK government's fresh incentives______ 主语是带定语的名词 短语 the UK government's fresh incentives，According to Confor 作状语指明信息源； 【定位】P2 Coming at a time of fresh incentives from the UK government for landowners to grow more trees, the trade body says these don't go far enough and fail to promote the benefits of planting them to boost timber supplies. 【选项】A) ✓ 正确 don't go far enough ↔ can hardly address a construction crisis a future construction crisis ↔ a construction crisis 预判的"力度不够、解决不了未来建筑危机"在 can hardly address a construction 原文 Coming at a time of fresh incentives 只是表示"在新激励出台之际"的时间背景， 并未评价时机对错；come at a wrong time 把中性时间状语扭曲为负面评价。 原文批评激励"做得不够"，并未说激励本身误导 landowners；misleading for too costly to put into practice 把评价点转到"成本太高、执行不起"，原文从未讨论激

questions.question: The UK's exposure to fluctuating wood prices is a result of______.

options.A: the government's inaction on timber imports
options.C: the competition among timber traders at home
options.D: wood producers' motive to maximise profits

questions.analysis: 【判型】题干 is a result of 直白追问原因，是原文中已明示因果关系的细节查找，未 含 infer/imply。 【拆句】The UK's exposure to fluctuating wood prices is a result of______ 主语 The UK's exposure to fluctuating wood prices 较长，核心名词为 exposure；系动词 is + a result 【定位】P2 For decades we have not taken responsibility for investing in our domestic wood supply, leaving us exposed to fluctuating prices and fighting for future supplies of wood as global demand rises and our own supplies fall. 【选项】A) 偷换概念 on timber imports 把矛头转到 imports，与原文因果链脱节。 B) ✓ 正确 have not taken responsibility for investing in our domestic wood supply ↔ inadequate investment in growing wood our domestic wood supply ↔ growing wood 预判的"几十年未投资本土供应"在 inadequate investment in growing wood 中以"对 competition among timber traders at home 在文本里找不到对应；原文谈的是与全 球争夺供应（fighting for future supplies of wood as global demand rises），不是 wood producers' motive to maximise profits 把价格波动归咎于木材生产商追求利润 最大化；原文对"producers' motive/profits"完全没提，纯属强加。

questions.question: Which of the following causes the shortage of wood supply in the UK?

options.C: Outdated technologies of the wood industry.

questions.analysis: 【判型】题干 Which of the following causes the shortage of wood supply 是从原文已列举原因 【拆句】Which of the following causes the shortage of wood supply in the UK? 是一个 wh-词 作主语的疑问句，causes 是谓语动词，宾语为 the shortage of wood supply，结构直 【定位】P3 The causes of the UK's current position are complex and range from outdated perceptions of productive forestry to the decimation of trees by grey squirrels. It also encompasses significant hesitation on behalf of farmers and other landowners to invest in longer-term planting projects. 【选项】A) 无中生有 Excessive timber consumption in construction 原文从未把"建筑业过度消耗"列为原 因；本段只在 productive forestry 与 grey squirrels 与 hesitation 三项里列因，且全 原文明确 The UK has ideal conditions for growing wood to build low-carbon homes，Unfavourable conditions for growing wood 把"理想条件"反成"不利条 原文是 outdated perceptions of productive forestry，主语是 perceptions（观念/看 法）；选项 Outdated technologies of the wood industry 把 perceptions 偷换成 technologies（技术），属概念偷换。 D) ✓ 正确 significant hesitation on behalf of farmers and other landowners to invest in longer-term planting projects ↔ Farmers' unwillingness to plant trees farmers and other landowners ↔ Farmers' 原文清单中第三项 hesitation...to invest in longer-term planting projects 与 Farmers' unwillingness to plant trees 主体一致、心理一致、对象一致，故选 D。

questions.question: What does Goodall think the UK government should do?

options.A: Subsidise the building of low-carbon homes.
options.B: Pay greater attention to boosting rural economies.

sections.directions: Part B Directions:Read the following text and match each of the numbered items in the left column to its corresponding information in the right column. There are two extra choices in the right column. Mark your answers on the ANSWER SHEET. (10 points)

blocks.content: High school students eager to stand out in the college application process often participate in a litany of extracurricular activities hoping to bolster their chances of admission to a selective undergraduate institution. However, college admissions experts say that the quality of a college hopeful's extracurricular activities matters more than the number of activities he or she participates in. Sue Rexford, the director of college guidance at the Charles E. Smith Jewish Day School, says it is not necessary for a student filling out the Common Application to list 10 activities in the application. "No college will expect that a student has a huge laundry list of extracurriculars that they have been passionately involved in each for an extended period of time," Rexford wrote in an email. Experts say it is tougher to distinguish oneself in a school-affiliated extracurricular activity that is common among high school students than it is to stand out while doing an uncommon activity. "The competition to stand out and make an impact is going to be much stiffer, and so if they're going to do a popular activity, I'd say, be the best at it," says Sara Harberson, a college admissions consultant. High school students who have an impressive personal project they are working on independently often impress colleges, experts say. "For example, a student with an interest in entrepreneurship could demonstrate skill and potential by starting a profitable small business," Olivia Valdes, the founder of Zen Admissions consulting firm, wrote in an email. Joseph Adegboyega-Edun, a Maryland high school guidance counselor, says unconventional extracurricular activities can help students impress college admissions offices, assuming they demonstrated serious commitment. "Again, since one of the big questions high school seniors must consider is 'What makes you unique?,' having an uncommon extracurricular activity vs. a conventional one is an advantage," he wrote in an email. Experts say demonstrating talent in at least one extracurricular activity can help in the college admissions process, especially at top-tier undergraduate institutions. "Distinguishing yourself in one focused type of extracurricular activity can be a positive in the admissions process, especially for highly selective institutions, where having top grades and test scores is not enough," Katie Kelley, admissions counselor at IvyWise admissions consultancy, wrote in an email. "Students need to have that quality or hook that will appeal to admissions officers and allow them to visualize how the student might come and enrich their campus community." Extracurricular activities related to the college major declared on a college application are beneficial, experts suggest. "If you already know your major, having an extracurricular that fits into that major can be a big plus," says Mayghin Levine, the manager of educational opportunities with The Cabbage Patch Settlement House, a Louisville, Kentucky, nonprofit community center. High school students who have had a strong positive influence on their community through an extracurricular activity may impress a college and win a scholarship, says Erica Gwyn, a former math and science magnet program assistant at a public high school who is now executive director of the Kaleidoscope Careers Academy in Atlanta, a nonprofit organization. extracurricular activity will be favored by top- tier institutions.
